tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Germanic alja, 'other, foreign', or a short form of names containing alja. Its root is Germanic alja. A Christian name used across Europe. Ella is a Germanic name meaning “She; (also) beautiful fairy; light”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
